events.title: Dramaworks Evening 2026
events.description: Excellent HSC Drama Performances from across the North Coast and Northern Rivers Schools.

events.title: Bombshells
events.description: With singing, dancing, comedy and the joys of sheer honesty, Joanna Murray-Smith's acclaimed play Bombshells is a journey from crisis to hilarity, via the thoughts of a group of women all linked by more than just their proximity to the edge; a nervous bride-to-be, an exhausted young mother, a widow with a yearning for the unexpected, a broken-hearted cactus lover, and a feisty teenage talent-quest competitor.

events.title: Common Wealth
events.description: Common Wealth is an intimate yet globally minded documentary that follows filmmaker Kane Guglielmi on a personal journey to question the economic and political systems that shape modern life.

events.title: Victorian State Ballet presents Beauty and The Beast
events.description: Featuring internationally recognised artists in leading roles in a rich display of outstanding skill! One of the world’s most loved fairy tale classics is retold through excellent staging, beautiful costumes, superb classical ballet skill and choreography which honour the spirit of this magical work - an inspiring, impacting, entertaining and memorable experience for the whole family!

events.title: THE BOX SHOW by Junkyard Beats
events.description: Get ready for THE BOX SHOW — an award-winning, interactive family theatre adventure from Junkyard Beats , directed and co-written by Nigel Turner-Carroll .

events.title: Julian Lage
events.description: Julian Lage tours Australia for the first time, continuing celebrations of his breakthrough solo album from 2015, 'World's Fair'.

events.title: Bringing the Natural World to Theatre Practice
events.description: Two-Day Nature Immersion Masterclass with Waangenga Saturday 19 & Sunday 20 September | 8:30am–3:30pm each day ‍

events.title: The Honey Sliders' Mix Tape
events.description: Press rewind and start from the top - this is The Honey Sliders’ Mix Tape. A carefully curated collection of songs, arranged in a special sequence to celebrate the music that inspired, influenced, and shaped the band’s journey. Like the classic cassette compilations of decades past, The Mix Tape unfolds across two sides, taking audiences on a musical road trip through beloved classics, hidden treasures, and unforgettable moments from the golden age of rock, soul, country, folk, and blues.

events.title: Byron Seniors: Chair Yoga
events.description: ‍ About the class Stay active, flexible and relaxed with Chair Yoga, a gentle Hatha practice designed for seniors. Each session blends mindful movement, breathwork, relaxation and short guided meditation. No experience is needed, simply come as you are and enjoy friendly, supported practice. Expect improvements in mobility, balance and overall wellbeing.

events.title: Tai Chi
events.description: This gentle and flowing Tai Chi course is based on a program developed by Dr Paul Lam for people with arthritis, but is suitable for anyone looking to improve their strength, flexibility and balance.

events.title: Art Space: Fletcher Street Cottage
events.description: Express yourself through art! Whether it's painting, drawing, clay or collage, this is your chance to explore your creativity.

events.title: Byron Seniors Club: Elder Beats Drumming
events.description: “The seniors that attend this amazing session are some of the most vibrant energetic characters of their age on the planet.” – Gareth Jones, Sound Synergy
